notes.title: Multiplayer PvP Bowshot! – UPDATE #4
notes.content:
Get ready to face off in PvP BOWSHOT!  

Our updated Bowshot multiplayer mode lets players face off in a single arena with the goal of racking up more points than your opponent.  To earn points, you’ll need to be fast and accurate as you attempt to shoot enemies before your opponent in this wave-based shooter. 

Of course, we added Helper and Hinder powerups for an added element of fun. 

Helper – the charged shot becomes instant so every shot deals increased damage for a limited time
Hinder – put a force-field around your opponent to block their arrows from reaching their target

notes.title: Multiplayer PvP Fracture! - UPDATE #3
notes.content:
Today we are releasing PvP for FRACTURE and have updated SMASH multipalyer.  

We are excited to release our multiplayer experience for Fracture where players will face off against another opponent in a race to see who can break down their walls first.  

That’s not it!  We are also introducing a new feature – Helper & Hinder to our multiplayer games. 

These “Helper” and “Hinder” powerups allow you to either help yourself or hinder the other player. What type of player are you?  

Fracture
Helper - instantly turn your ball into a Fire Ball, which will help clear away many bricks quickly.
Hinder - will add devil bricks to your opponent's playfield.    

Smash
Helper - split a single ball into two for double the opportunity to score.
Hinder – disable your opponent’s ability to use their Slow Shots. 

Oh and don't worry, Bowshot is coming soon.

notes.title: UPDATE #2 - Multiplayer PvP Smash!
notes.content:
We are releasing the PvP mode for SMASH (BETA version), complete with worldwide leaderboards.   Players will now be able to face off against other players throughout the world and match their skills.  

This is our initial release, so more to come soon.

Tip – remember to use your Slow Shot and add Spin – those skills are key to victory!

The team is also finalizing on PvP modes for Fracture and Bowshot, so keep an eye out for those games as they will be released soon.

notes.title: UPDATE #1
notes.content: We are continuing to support Arcade Saga. This is the first of many updates, but the last update of the year.  We focused on polish items for this round but are excited about what next year will bring! Stay tuned.
